description: The connected X account's LIVE VIDEO broadcasts: past and current ones (title, state, share URL, live and total viewers, start/end) and SCHEDULED ones (start, end, whether it goes live automatically or waits for go_live). kind 'all' (default) reads both, 'live' or 'scheduled' one; pass id for a single broadcast. Read-only. Needs X connected with the broadcast permissions added 2026-09-21: an X connection made before then must be reconnected once under Settings > Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

id.description: one broadcast id (alphanumeric, up to 24 characters)

ids.description: comma-separated broadcast ids (live kind, up to 100)

newestStart.description: scheduled kind: latest start, ISO 8601 or epoch ms

oldestStart.description: scheduled kind: earliest start, ISO 8601 or epoch ms

paginationToken.description: next page token from the previous reply

name: list_x_broadcasts
title: List X live broadcasts
